rooms.title: The Enchanted Cellar
rooms.description: You find yourself in a dimly lit cellar with the scent of ancient wine and mystery.

rooms.title: Crystal Chamber of Reflection
rooms.description: You find yourself in an underground chamber illuminated by the ethereal glow of shimmering crystals that seem to pulse with hidden magic.

rooms.title: Abyssal Cavern Passage
rooms.description: You find yourself standing before a narrow staircase descending deeper into the earth, its walls lined with ancient runes that seem to pulse faintly.
